brief:
An economic researcher's field survey in Gaza reveals significant disparities in food assistance distribution, with 62.5% of surveyed households receiving no aid over a three-month period, Shehab Wire reported. Economist Ahmad Abu Qamr conducted the survey to assess how relief supplies reach residents across the enclave.

The findings have prompted calls to strengthen transparency in aid distribution and establish unified beneficiary databases to ensure equitable coverage and prevent gaps in reaching vulnerable populations.
